name: smwpatches-koopa-feet-patch
title: Koopa Feet Patch
description:
This patch turns the koopa's eyes into the more commonly seen foot graphic from SMB1, 2J and 3...

This patch also includes the new foot graphic, so make sure to upload that GFX file to your hack before use!

ALSO: There is also a more simple patch included that can be optionally removed... It's to make it like the original koopas from SMB3, but it's original unlike the other patch!

Thanks for Vitor Vilela for the vague fix, I figured it needs to be addressed that the fix is to use FinishOAMWrite according to the disassembly
